node-taglib-sharp returns RIFF INFO values with the trailing NUL terminator (tag.title/comment/genres and InfoTag.getValuesAsStrings); a read-then-save round trip writes the NUL back as data inside the sub-chunk size. ffprobe hides NULs, so NUL evidence comes from raw INFO bytes (tests/main/riff-chunks.ts parseListInfoSubChunks or an equivalent dump), never from ffprobe alone.
